settings.title: Settings

settings.vibrationNote: A short vibration when your turn begins.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body: Every colour has 21 pieces. Place as many of them on the board as you can. The highest score wins – and has the winter.

turn.title: A turn
turn.body: On your turn you place one piece on the board. When none of your pieces fits any more, your turns are skipped for the rest of the game. The game ends when nobody can place a piece.

place.title: Placing a piece
place.body: Your first piece covers your own starting corner. After that every piece must touch your colour at a corner, but never along a side. Other colours may be touched freely. Choose a piece below, turn or mirror it and tap a spot on the board; tap the piece again to place it. Hint puts the bot's move ready.

score.title: Scoring
score.body: Every square left off the board costs a point. Placing all your pieces earns 15 points, and 5 more when the last piece was the single square.

pictures.start: The first piece on the starting corner
pictures.corner: Corner contact with your colour: allowed
pictures.edge: Side contact with your colour: not allowed

variants.title: Variants
variants.classic: Classic: 2–4 players on the 20×20 board, each playing their own colour from a corner.
variants.duo: Duo: two players on a small 14×14 board. The start squares are inside the board, not in the corners.
variants.double: Double: two players with two colours each. The colours’ scores are added up.
variants.trio: Trio: three players. The fourth colour, Kuusi, is played in turns, and its score counts for no one.

about.trio: 3 players, the fourth colour taken in turns

puzzle.title: Daily puzzle
puzzle.entryBody: Fill today's shape with pieces. The same puzzle for everyone, a new one every morning.
puzzle.intro: Fill the shape with all {{count}} pieces. No corner rule here.
puzzle.aim: Tap a spot in the shape – the piece slides to the nearest place it fits
puzzle.ready: Tap the piece again or press Place
puzzle.lift: Tap a placed piece to pick it back up
puzzle.OFF_SHAPE: The piece slips outside the shape
puzzle.tomorrow: Tomorrow a new shape freezes into view.
